title.narrative: Strengthening of tuberculosis care and prevention, with a focus on case finding activities, in Bangladesh - Bangladesh (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Bangladesh, Tuberculosis, BRAC (BRAC)This program has the following goals: Reduce the incidence of TB (all forms) by 20% by 2020 and 90% by 2035 (from 2015 baseline figure 225/100000). The objectives of this program are: Increase annual case detection of all forms of TB to 86% of all incident cases by 2020 from baseline of 61% in 2016. Maintain a treatment success rate of over 90% in all forms of detected non-MDR TB cases.. Increase annual case detection of MDR- TB to 1,898 cases by 2020 from baseline of 969 in 2016.. Ensure that no TB-affected families facing catastrophic costs due to tuberculosis by 2020. Ensure that 100% of TB service facilities receive regular supervision and monitoring with appropriate feedback resulting in remedial actions by 2020
